profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Work on the most challenging software projects that can potentially have a huge impact on the world.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I lead engineering efforts across five major projects, delivering cutting-edge solutions that drive significant impact. My work includes designing and developing RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures to harness Google's powerful AI for process automation, and building scalable platforms that boost revenue and enhance operational efficiency.

positions.title: Web Solutions Engineer
positions.description: Deliver innovative solutions to help drive revenue and make Google even more efficient. As a Web Solutions Engineer, my responsibilities include rapid prototyping proofs of concept, developing and supporting tools and core products to meet the needs of our customers and users.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Develop advanced technical solutions in the form of software applications that save time to users, improve efficiency and enable Google to scale at an unprecedented rate.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I was responsible to build systems for facility management for very large corporations like BNP and Santander Bank. I was involved on all the phases of a software project and specially focused on design and development.

positions.title: Agile Developer
positions.description: I developed a highly scalable architecture for monitoring and controlling a biogas factory.

certifications.name: Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification
certifications.title: Supervised Machine Learning: Regression and Classification

publications.title: A Systematic and Lightweight Method to Identify Dependencies between User Stories
